1.value: Last Train from Yio Chu Kang

2.value: 1-4 player co-op zombie survival in a Singapore HDB estate, by Serendipity. Scavenge the void decks, craft what the island left you, restore three substations, and board the last North-South line train at T+12:00 — or walk to the kampong and kill the Broodmother. Death is not elimination: the fallen defect to the horde and play against the living. Default seed 20260807; replay any run with -seed N before your first search. Built headlessly with wc3-map-toolkit.
